model_message.content:
I now have direct config evidence of the area mismatch:

- r1 eth1: `ip ospf area 0.0.0.1` (E007)
- r2 eth1: `ip ospf area 0.0.0.0` (E008)

Neither interconnect interface is passive (`ospf_passive_config` only shows `router ospf`, and eth1 configs have no `ip ospf passive`). Interfaces are UP on both sides. This confirms area mismatch as root cause, consistent with zero neighbors on both sides (E005, E006).

No OSPF routes on either side, consistent with the area mismatch causing no adjacency. Evidence is sufficient to identify the root cause: the two interconnect interfaces are in different OSPF areas (Area 0.0.0.1 on r1 vs Area 0.0.0.0 on r2), both interfaces are administratively UP, and neither is passive. This explains the empty neighbor tables and absence of OSPF routes.
